messages:
maria_devex: quick check — cutting quickstart/docs/sampleapp for tomorrow's launch. Owners: @sam_engineering (sample app), @kevin_docs (docs), @oliver_sampleapps (packaging). Need CRs merged, changelog slice done, and a smoke run ✅. Any blockers?

sam_engineering: CR #342 landed but failing lint on CI, looking. pinging @jenna_re for validation tests.

jenna_re: running smoke tests now — one flake in auth flow, investigating. Will post logs.

sam_engineering: thanks. lint fix pushed in #343, should be green soon.

kevin_docs: changelog slice is drafted at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/198 — waiting for final wording from sam. Also doc snippet for new quickstart CLI included.

maria_devex: @sam can you confirm CLI flags stable? docs PR needs exact names.

oliver_sampleapps: packaging note — sampleapp binary needs the env var rename (REDWOOD_API -> RW_API). I can add a migration note in sampleapp readme.

sam_engineering: CLI flags stable; renaming env var is intentional but small breaking change. I'll add a compat alias in code so old var still works for this release.

jenna_re: smoke run results: most flows pass. Failing case details:
`````
Error: token timeout in oauth callback
stack: ...
`````
I suspect a race with startup ordering.

sam_engineering: will add a 200ms backoff on startup; patch in #344.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview finished — staging URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/quickstart. Tests: 12/13 passing.

maria_devex: OK — plan: 1) merge #343 lint, #344 startup fix, #342 sampleapp, 2) kevin to merge docs PR after confirm, 3) run final smoke and prod publish. Target window: 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow. Anyone can't make it?

kevin_docs: I can merge once sam confirms alias. Will wait on green CI.

oliver_sampleapps: packaging build queued, but will hold final publish until docs merged.

sam_engineering: all green on my side. merging now. :thumbsup:

maria_devex: awesome — if anything else, drop a quick note here. :rocket:
